summary:
This bill would cancel a government rule made by the Army Corps of Engineers, the Department of Defense, and the Environmental Protection Agency.

The rule is called “Revised Definition of ‘Waters of the United States.’” It was published on January 18, 2023. The rule is about which waters count as “waters of the United States” under federal law.

Congress is using a process that lets it reject some agency rules. An agency is a part of the government that carries out laws.

If this bill becomes law, Congress would officially disapprove that rule. The rule would have “no force or effect.” That means the rule could not be used or enforced.

The House of Representatives passed this bill on March 9, 2023. It was received in the Senate on March 14, 2023.
